# News

Stay up to date with the latest announcements, publications, and events from the *M@TE* community.

---

- **June 2026** - *M@TE* website revamp - now powered by [Quarto](https://quarto.org/)

- **June 2025** - NCI recognises *M@TE* in 2025-annual [report](https://nci.org.au/about-us/annual-reports), page 34.

- **Jan 2025** - *M@TE* features on the RO-crate [website](https://www.researchobject.org/ro-crate/mate)
